name: Agretes

attributes.attribute: refused to aid a pilgrim bearing the Grail

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Agretes was an Arthurian hero. He reigned over Camelot long before King Arthur took its throne. He refused to assist a pilgrim from the Holy Land who bore a great chalice called the Grail. Because of that refusal, he was stricken mad and died.

okr.objective: Record the reign and fate of Agretes, a king before Arthur.
key_results: Show his refusal to aid the grail pilgrim and its consequence.
